prompt.text: Use code 1 for a table, 2 for a bar graph, 3 for a pictogram, 4 for a line graph and 5 for a pie chart. A dashboard must show exact values for 25 branches and allow users to compare several measures within each branch. Compact accuracy is essential. For the reason code, use 1 if a bar graph cannot have labelled branches, 2 if a bar graph can show only one measure, or 3 if grouped bars for 25 branches would be crowded and the exact values would be hard to read. Enter a two-digit number: the first digit is the code of the most suitable display and the second digit is the reason code.

content.text: Decide which matters more here: the exact values or an overall picture.

Each of the 25 branches has several exact figures that users must read and compare. Choose the display that can hold many exact figures side by side, then think about what grouped bars for 25 branches would look like.
A table holds every exact figure for all 25 branches in a compact layout. Grouped bars for 25 branches would be crowded and their exact values would be hard to read, so the reason code is 3.
